## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe what this change fixes or enables. English or Russian is welcome.

## Related issue

Link the issue, if any. Use `Fixes #...` only if this PR resolves it fully.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For documentation changes, check links and both README languages. For UI changes, include the OS and a screenshot with demo data.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and changelog were updated where applicable.
- [ ] Screenshots and logs contain no credentials or personal account data.
